name: Standardized capability horizon
formal_definition: Human-expert task duration at which the release-frontier model succeeds 50 percent under a frozen scaffold task suite and budget
doubling_time_definition: ln2 divided by local slope of ln horizon versus release date
notes: METR Time Horizon 1.1 is current implementation; H80 is a reliability guardrail

name: Fixed-capability inference delivered per dollar
formal_definition: Sustained standardized inference delivered per inflation-adjusted dollar by the cheapest public system meeting a frozen one-human-hour H50 capability threshold at fixed latency availability context and bulk volume
doubling_time_definition: ln2 divided by local slope of ln service units per dollar versus date
notes: Requires a new cost and service-level series; nominal API price alone does not qualify
